mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a weakening consumer demand, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals labor market weakness, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL below 2% YoY) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 2%) signals accommodative monetary policy, which boosts equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: low inflation, low interest rate environment
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over 3 months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the proxy shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals labor market contraction, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in a month signals a strengthening consumer demand and labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.
